facts.fact: Heads of Djibouti Telecom, Ethio Telecom and Sudatel signed in Djibouti on Wednesday 4 February 2026 the agreement launching Horizon, a terrestrial fibre corridor of nearly 2,800 km with 144 fibre pairs joining Djibouti, Addis Ababa and Port Sudan.
A memorandum of understanding for Horizon was signed in Addis Ababa on 4 December 2024.

systems.owner: Djibouti Telecom, Ethio Telecom, Sudatel Group
